biggest_catch: Long day: arrive by 6:15 AM, polls 7 AM-8 PM, then close and return supplies to the county office; total pay is $210 including the $30 training stipend.
catches: Clerks & Machine Inspectors: $180 for election day + $30 for training = $210 total.
A two-hour training is available before every election; $30 training pay is included in election day pay.
Polls are open 7 AM-8 PM; poll workers must arrive by 6:15 AM and stay after 8 PM to close and return supplies.
Judge of Election ($180 + $30 + supply mileage extras) is an elected position and is not the accessible route.
Qualifications: U.S. citizen, Berks County resident, registered voter.

steps: Meet eligibility: U.S. citizen, Berks County resident, registered voter.
Apply/accept appointment as a Clerk through the Minority Inspector or Board of Elections.
Attend the two-hour training before the election ($30 training pay).
Work Election Day: arrive by 6:15 AM, serve 7 AM-8 PM, close polls and return supplies.
timing: Election Day ~6:15 AM-9:00 PM (including close/return of supplies) plus a two-hour training session.
